findings.title: Protected API route allowed unauthenticated access
findings.expected: Protected API routes return 401 without a session or bearer token.
findings.fixCandidate: Ensure protected routes mount authMiddleware before handlers.

findings.title: API token could access a super-admin route
findings.expected: Bearer API tokens are denied from super-admin-only routes.
findings.observed: Super-admin route returned HTTP 200 for a bearer token.
findings.fixCandidate: Reject req.isApiToken inside superAdminMiddleware unless scoped token support exists.

findings.title: Local file upload accepted bytes that did not match declared size

reproduction: POST a much shorter body to /api/files/:id/local-upload.

findings.expected: Local upload rejects body length that differs from pending file size_bytes.
findings.fixCandidate: Compare received buffer length with file.size_bytes before writing local upload.

findings.title: Uploaded HTML was served inline without nosniff protection

reproduction: Upload text/html content through local file upload.

findings.expected: User uploads are served as attachments with X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.
findings.fixCandidate: Serve local uploads as attachments, sanitize filenames, and set X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.
